description: This file defines an interface for managing initial resource values in a device configuration context. It includes type definitions, creation and destruction functions, and methods to add, check, retrieve, and log resource values for devices and endpoints.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the initial resource values set.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a given instance of initial resource values, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutDeviceValue
methods.description: Sets or replaces the initial value for a device resource identified by resourceId.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutDeviceValueIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets the initial value for a device resource only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutEndpointValue
methods.description: Sets or replaces the initial value for an endpoint resource given endpointId and resourceId.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesPutEndpointValueIfNotExists
methods.description: Sets the initial value for an endpoint resource only if it does not already exist.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesHasDeviceValue
methods.description: Checks if there is an initial value (even if NULL) for a specific device resource.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesHasEndpointValue
methods.description: Checks if there is an initial value (even if NULL) for a specific endpoint resource.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesGetDeviceValue
methods.description: Retrieves the initial value for a device resource; cannot distinguish between absent and NULL values.

methods.name: initialResourceValuesGetEndpointValue
methods.description: Retrieves the initial value for an endpoint resource; cannot distinguish between absent and NULL values.

methods.name: initialResourcesValuesLogValues
methods.description: Logs all set initial resource values.
